description: Exposes Microsoft Developer Blogs (devblogs.microsoft.com) — team-authored posts from the .NET, Visual Studio, C++, TypeScript, PowerShell, Azure SDK, Old New Thing, and other team blogs — as MCP tools: list known blogs, fetch recent posts, search by keyword within the feed window, browse archives by year/month, batch fetch titles, and retrieve full article text.
name: io.github.christian289/microsoft-devblogs-mcp-server
